**On-the-Go Learning Template (Rideshare Focus)**

**Context:** Door-to-door rideshares – these offer a relatively relaxed environment, allowing for focused learning.

**Burnout Prevention Strategies:**

*   **Timeboxing:** Set a timer for 15-30 minutes of learning per rideshare. When the timer goes off, switch to a different activity or simply enjoy the ride.

*   **No-Learning Zones:** Designate certain rides (e.g., when you're tired or stressed) as "no-learning" zones.

*   **Modified Jacobs Ladder:** Start with very short intervals (e.g., 30-60 seconds) on the Jacobs Ladder at a low speed, focusing on maintaining good posture and avoiding any shoulder discomfort.
